name: Spark USDC V1 (Legacy)
oneLiner: sUSDC is Spark's legacy USDC savings share, backed by sUSDS and redeemable through Sky PSM liquidity or an sUSDS escape hatch.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Five official native ERC-4626 deployments issue Spark USDC Vault shares against equal local sUSDS share balances: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism and Unichain. Ethereum converts USDC through the Sky PSM and deposits USDS into sUSDS; L2 vaults swap USDC directly for bridged sUSDS through PSM3. USDC is the deposit and ordinary redemption denomination, not the predominant reserve asset. The legacy V1 instrument is separate from Spark Savings V2 and the Spark-branded Morpho lending vaults. Official registries, the ChainSecurity assessment and pinned 2026-10-15 reads establish the protocol-position archetype.

collateral: Locally held sUSDS shares on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism and Unichain, plus residual USDC and Ethereum USDS dust. L2 sUSDS is a canonical bridge representation of Sky savings shares; ultimate Sky backing and bridge risks remain upstream.
pegMechanism: Deposit USDC to obtain sUSDS and mint an equal number of sUSDC shares. Ethereum uses the Sky PSM and sUSDS; L2 vaults use PSM3 with a trusted cross-chain savings-rate provider. Ordinary USDC exits depend on the respective PSM's liquidity and, on Ethereum, tin/tout fees. exit() burns sUSDC for the matching local sUSDS shares without using PSM liquidity.

dependencyReview.rationale: Pinned asset() getters identify native USDC on all five independently issued legacy vaults. USDC is the serial denomination and tracked variant parent; held local sUSDS, including its L2 bridge representations, is separately linked through reserve composition. These independently deposit-backed sUSDC supplies sum; remote sUSDC is not minted against escrowed Ethereum sUSDC.
